about_the_game:
THE LAST WEREWOLF Supporter Pack is a collection of digital assets designed for fans who want to immerse themselves further in the game's world and help fund future development. It contains 100% digital content based on the in-game world and lore.

What's Inside:

  • Digital Colouring Book & Pages (PDF & PNG): A complete colouring book featuring 13 unique illustrations from Lachie's website, provided both as a ready-to-print PDF and as individual high-resolution PNG files perfect for digital colouring.

  • Books and Magazines (PDF): A single PDF containing the full text of all in-game books and magazines (such as King Omega and Paranormal Papers). These are the complete, readable documents found in the game's library, compiled into a convenient PDF document.

  • Lachie's Spooky Tales Blogs (PDF): All 13 of Lachie's original blog entries, covering supernatural and ghostly topics, collected in a single, convenient PDF file for easy reading.

Note on Printing:

  • Colouring Pages: These pages are in a square format. When printing on standard A4 or Letter paper, please select the 'Fit to Page' or 'Scale to Fit' option in your printer settings to ensure proper sizing.

  • In-Game Booklets: These PDF documents are formatted in A5 size (half of standard A4/Letter paper). We recommend checking your printer's settings to select 'A5' paper or use the 'Fit to Page' option for best results.

Where to Find the DLC

All Supporter Pack items can be found in your game's installation folder.

1. Open your Steam Library.

2. Right-click on The Last Werewolf, then select Manage > Browse local files.

3. The content will be located inside the Supporter Pack folder.

License & Copyright:

License & Usage: All content in this pack is licensed for personal, non-commercial use only. You must not redistribute or sell these items digitally or physically. We do, however, encourage you to share your creativity, such as posting completed colouring pages on social media, community hubs, or forums

Official Retail Products: Official paperback versions of our books are available to purchase only through the Unnatural Freaks website or at events we attend. Any other sale of these documents is unauthorised by us.
